mission: Your camera box is sitting on top of the game's ammo and kill info. Keep your face in the clip, but stop it covering that game info, then export it.

checkpoints.describe: A layout that keeps the facecam clear of the game UI is applied

why.data: Quick users reuse or pick a layout and export; picking the right one by its effect, not its name, is the Layouts job (72.6% reuse the previous layout).
